items.title: Aaron Rodgers: Set to be waived

items.title: Derrick Henry: In protocol, but should play Sunday
items.text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Henry was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice after being placed back in concussion protocol, but the running back is expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Texans, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports.
